inputs.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 close-up photo of one large classic orange pumpkin, completely uncarved: smooth intact skin with natural ribs and a curly stem. The pumpkin is big in the frame, centered, filling about 75% of the image width and most of the height, sitting on a wooden porch step at night, facing the camera. Dark porch background with a softly blurred warm wall lantern, autumn leaves on the step, shallow depth of field. No carving, no face, no drawing, no candle, no glow, no hands, no people, no text, no watermark.

A photo of a real hand-carved pumpkin: the subject is sculpted entirely out of pumpkin material (orange rind, cream flesh, dark cut-through holes), like a monochrome relief sculpture; its face, hair and clothes are carved pumpkin flesh, never real skin, real hair, fabric or cartoon paint. Edit image 1 (the blank pumpkin on the porch): keep the exact same pumpkin at the exact same size and position, same stem, porch, camera angle and lighting. Hand-carve the subject from image 2 into the front of this pumpkin as a REAL physical pumpkin carving, like a professional pumpkin-sculpting photo. Image 2 is the design to carve. The result must be instantly recognizable as the subject of image 2: copy its exact outer silhouette (head shape, ears, hair outline), and the exact shape and position of its eyes, nose, mouth and expression, plus clothing or held objects. Do NOT turn it into a generic jack-o'-lantern face, do NOT add triangle eyes or teeth that are not in image 2. Eyes, nose and mouth are carved in shaded relief with their real shape (pupils, lids, lips), never punched out as hollow jack-o'-lantern holes. Carving technique: only the darkest background and clothing areas are cut fully through the rind as true holes, dark voids showing the hollow inside, with the rind thickness visible on the cut edges. Mid-tones are scraped/shaved relief where the orange skin is removed to expose pale yellow-cream pumpkin flesh at varying depths, with gouge and knife marks. The lightest areas keep the original orange skin. Wet fibrous pulp texture, slightly uneven hand-cut edges, the design wraps around the pumpkin's curvature and ribs and is lit by the same porch light with real shadows inside the cuts. The only colors on the pumpkin are orange skin, pale cream flesh, and dark shadowed holes: do not copy any colors, skin tones, hair color or fabric from image 2. NOT a photo pasted in, NOT a sticker, NOT a decal, NOT a print, NOT flat vector art, NO uniform flat beige fill, NO clean outline, NO cartoon colors pasted on. No candle, no flame, no glow, no text, no watermark.

Hyperlapse of real pumpkin carving, sped up like a documentary time-lapse. Locked camera, no camera move. Start on the blank uncarved pumpkin in the first frame. Real hands and a small carving knife enter and cut fast, sawing and punching clean silhouette openings through the rind until the face matches the last frame exactly. Fast cutting pace, visible knife strokes and pumpkin scraps, natural skin texture, real porch at night. Ambient porch light only. Carved openings stay dark empty voids with nothing lit inside. End on the finished silhouette, matching the last frame design, pumpkin, and porch. Do not invent a generic jack-o'-lantern face. No candle, no flame, no fire, no torch, no internal glow, no smoke, no CGI, no plastic look, no morphing. No whip pans, no text, no watermarks.
